result:
Disk full killed the api. `report-export` job started 03:05:00, wrote 40 × 512 MB CSVs (~20 GB) to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` in under 8 min, same volume as the database → disk 91% at 03:09:03 → 99% at 03:13:30 → 03:14:00 `db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` → 03:14:03 api aborted transaction, shut down worker pool → 03:14:06 `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)`.

Api never came back: last api request 03:13:51, then `proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 min from 03:16:00 through log end (05:29:57), 67 total. No restart or recovery line anywhere, so still down when log stops, 2h16m+. Web and proxy kept serving their own requests 200 throughout.

Red herring: `cache: slow command` WARNs (100–149 ms) run every ~5 min from 02:00, before and after the crash, unchanged pattern → unrelated.

Two caveats. Log timestamps are 2026-03-09, not last night (today 2026-10-05) — confirm this is the right file. And the log doesn't show what triggered the export or why nothing restarted the api; no reference to `report-export` exists in the repo outside the log, so the job lives somewhere else.

Likely needed before restart: free space in `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, else db fails again on first write.
